purpose: Freeze a retail-derived parent movement/collision trace and name the exact prerequisites for a valid HCU comparison.

limitations: This is a parent-only reference trace, not a CE comparison.
The generated HP2 COLL section is the parent converter format; it is not the CE relocated tag-block collision_bsp representation.
The variable wall-clock bench line is excluded from trace hashing.

hcu_authority.current_runtime_requirement: A BSP must be mounted into CE collision tag blocks and global_collision_bsp_get() must resolve it before the CE calls can produce runtime collision traces.
hcu_authority.blocking_boundary: The current M2 guest has not yet emitted m2-ui-map-loaded or loaded a gameplay map/BSP into the resident CE cache. A UI BSP diagnostic package is not evidence of a gameplay resident BSP.

comparisons.parent_fixture: parent player trace includes floor, wall, slope, ceiling, corner, and fast sweep cases
blockers: No CE collision_bsp runtime object backed by the M2-resident gameplay BSP is available to the host harness.

comparisons.parent_fixture: retail Blood Gulch COLL-converted parent oracle
blockers: The parent COLL pack and HCU CE collision tag-block graph are different representations; the conversion output cannot be passed to collision_bsp_test_pill_new.
No M2 gameplay BSP materialization is available to bind CE tag blocks and globals.

comparisons.parent_fixture: No matching dynamic-object collision fixture exists in the parent movement harness.
blockers: The CE broad-phase and object collision path requires initialized object pool, map collision globals, and runtime object identity; parent structure-only pill sweep has no equivalent object collision authority.

comparisons.parent_fixture: tests/test_actor_collision.py validates static cyborg ACOL mesh extraction and damage-part metadata only; it does not execute actor hit collision.
blockers: No live CE actor datum, node pose, collision-model context, or actor collision dispatch is initialized in the available host fixture.

comparisons.parent_fixture: No HCU-equivalent projectile-vs-object trace exists in the parent player harness.
blockers: CE projectile collision is routed through CE object/collision state and needs a resident BSP plus live projectile/owner datums; a parent segment test alone would not be equivalent.

requirements_to_unblock: M2 must materialize a selected gameplay map and BSP into the real current_bsp/resident regions with source and CBIX extent identity recorded.
The host/guest fixture must initialize CE tag-block pointers, global collision BSP, object pool, collision flags, and breakable-surface state from that exact materialized BSP.

Use an identical tick-indexed input and collision query fixture on parent and CE; record hit fraction, normal, surface/material, final position/velocity, grounded state, and object handles where applicable.

Only compare object/actor/projectile behavior once each side has semantically equivalent actors, objects, owners, and collision filters; label non-equivalent parent cases as implementation gaps rather than parity.
Run CE trace twice and hash canonical output; retain the mismatch list without relaxing tolerances absent a source-backed numerical explanation.
